answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the ridge of a task receipt, and the yarrow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The sparrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
